env.description: Run the given command with .env.local loaded

env:dev.description: Run the given command with .env.dev, then .env.local, loaded

tasks.dev:web: deno task env:dev 'deno task --cwd src-svelte dev'
tasks.dev:tauri: deno task env:dev 'deno task --cwd src-svelte tauri dev --config "$TAURI_DEV_CONFIG"'
tasks.build:axum: deno task env 'cargo build -p web-book-3d-server --profile server'
tasks.build:web: deno task env 'deno task --cwd src-svelte build'
tasks.build:tauri: deno task env 'deno task --cwd src-svelte tauri build'
tasks.check:svelte: deno task env 'deno task --cwd src-svelte check'
tasks.tauri: deno task env 'deno task --cwd src-svelte tauri'
